body: I think we don't even need that since [mercurial requires python 3.5](https://www.mercurial-scm.org/wiki/SupportedPythonVersions) and [python 3.7 is preinstalled](https://github.com/actions/virtual-environments/blob/master/images/macos/macos-10.15-Readme.md#language-and-runtime).
